title: r1 minor SA: domain-lens entries stretch the affordance map beyond chassis-affordance scope — confirm the home
description: Evidence: act-to-affordance-map.md:17; the contract frames the map as the chassis-affordance closure and the substrate step's mechanisms as milestone/session/hook/skill/config — a composition member is not among them; the map becomes a second composition-routing surface. comments.content: OPERATOR RULING (2026-07-21, round-1 triage): the generalized map CONFIRMED.
